title: manni content strategy: journey record
description: A content-strategy journey: an end-to-end outcome a persona reaches with the docs. One record per file, under docs/content-strategy/journeys/. Every field after `type`, `id` and `personas` is optional.

type.description: Marks the file as a journey (critical user journey) record, which `manni strategy` reads.

id.description: The id pages and other records name this record by. Unique across every record.

title.description: The record's name, as `manni strategy list` and `get` show it.

description.description: One sentence that says who or what the record is.

personas.description: The ids of the persona records this journey serves. `manni strategy` builds its tree from this field, and a journey may serve several personas.

entry-point.description: The page the journey starts on, as a path or URL.

success-criteria.description: What the persona has when the journey succeeds.

steps.description: The journey's stages, each with the page that carries it.

stage.description: What the persona does at this stage.

doc.description: The page that carries the stage, as a path or URL.

note.description: Anything a reviewer of the stage needs to know.
